shared_api_sketch.name: TablePreviewComponent<Row, Key> (proposal)
shared_api_sketch.boundary: Generic shell owns stable-key selection, filtering/search text, table viewport/scroll, section labels, table/preview focus, split/stack geometry, close/requestRender hooks, and disposal. It does not know AgentRegistry, journals, tools, or transcript components.
shared_api_sketch.core: rows(): readonly Row[] or push/update projection; keyOf(row): Key; renderRow(row, {selected,width}): string; searchText(row): string; onSelectionChange(row|undefined); preview: { open(row|undefined): void|Promise<void>; render(width,height): readonly string[]; handleInput?(key): boolean; dispose?(): void }; optional footer/help and table/preview key delegates.
shared_api_sketch.important_contract: Rows are keyed, not index-addressed; preview replacement is transactional (dispose old before open new), render always flushes pending projection before reading rows, and component never writes session/transcript history. Hub adapter can retain transcript cache/live subscription; Dashboard inspector and Tools detail are pure preview adapters.

dump_inventory.current_behavior: ctx.present/showStatus/showError/showWarning/showNewVersion mount components into chatContainer; these are visible transcript append operations but not durable session entries.
dump_inventory.why: Command/status/error notifications should be ephemeral output, not conversation history. Existing command-line showOutput already proves the intended bottom overlay route (command-line.ts:236-256, 329-346).
Bounded command result; route through the command output overlay, not chat transcript.

order: 1. Characterize: add/retain tests for (a) `:tools` never calling ctx.present/chatContainer, (b) stable selected row through tool refresh, (c) Dashboard list/inspector geometry and selection, (d) Hub preview sealing/flush; no behavior changes yet.

2. Extract generic TablePreviewComponent from the Hub table/dual-lane mechanics behind its current behavior. Keep Hub projection, row renderers, journal/live transcript caches, g/fold/IRC actions, and all lifecycle timers in Hub adapter. Preserve mount geometry in SelectorController.

3. Migrate AgentDashboard body to the shared shell. Keep async discovery/settings/tabs, model edit, create-agent editor/review, and full-screen overlay lifecycle in AgentDashboard; supply keyed agent rows and pure inspector preview.

4. Migrate `:tools` to a ToolsView/adapter using getAllToolNames/getToolByName and the shared shell; preserve deterministic provenance rendering and inactive registered rows. Route command completion/output through a view overlay, not ctx.present. Keep buildToolsMarkdown for ACP/non-TUI until callers are explicitly migrated.

5. Delete duplicate list/split/scroll code only after both consumers and Hub tests pass; then audit every remaining ctx.present in command/extension/MCP controllers and convert only command/notification outputs, leaving real transcript/tool execution persistence untouched.
